verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs say you can add an MCP server such as Linear to an agent config, and Omnara then discovers its tools. That gives agents a documented first-party path to an issue tracker. However, it is a generic MCP connection: only Linear is named, and there is no dedicated issue-tracker integration or documented ticket-management workflow. Missing for 10: any mention of Jira, ClickUp or Monday.com, documentation of agents creating or updating tickets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Add a server such as Linear, Notion, or your own internal service to an agent config, and Omnara discovers its tools
Connect MCP servers to give them access to your services and data
